# Hello World Cards
> Pokémon cards, art, and events from Sam & Timo. A little shop that still feels like two friends sharing a hobby.

Hello World Cards is a small Pokémon card and art shop run by Sam and Timo. We sell online and at events in the Netherlands and Belgium. To buy a card, email helloworldcards@outlook.com or use the contact form.

## Pages
- [Home](https://helloworldcards.com/): Pokémon cards, art, and events from Sam & Timo. A little shop that still feels like two friends sharing a hobby.
- [Shop](https://helloworldcards.com/products): Browse our collection of Pokémon cards and art, pieces we love having around.
- [Upcoming events](https://helloworldcards.com/agenda): We'll be at these Pokémon events. Come say hi, browse the stall, and see what's new.
- [About](https://helloworldcards.com/about): We're Sam and Timo, a couple who turned a Pokémon hobby into Hello World Cards, a small shop for cards, art, and the events we go to.
- [Contact](https://helloworldcards.com/contact): Questions about a card, an event, or something in the shop? Send us a message. We'd love to hear from you.

## FAQ
### What is Hello World Cards?
A small Pokémon card and art shop run by Sam and Timo. We list what we have in stock and the events we go to.

### Who runs Hello World Cards?
Sam and Timo, a couple who turned a Pokémon hobby into this shop. Sam collects Wooper and Quagsire; Timo chases Gengar and Ralts.

### Do you have a physical shop?
No walk-in storefront. We sell online and in person at Pokémon events in the Netherlands and Belgium.

### What do you sell?
Pokémon cards (including graded cards) and Pokémon art. Browse the shop or email us about a piece.

### How do I buy a card?
Send a message with the card you want via the contact form or email. We reply at helloworldcards@outlook.com.

### How can I get in touch?
Email, the contact form, or Instagram @helloworldcards.

### Where can I meet you in person?
At the events on the agenda. We bring a stall to Pokémon shows in the Netherlands and Belgium.

## Products
- [Mewtwo Reverse Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/mewtwo-reverse-holo): 2016 XY Evolutions - 51/108. €99. This Mewtwo Reverse Foil #51 is from the popular 2016 Pokémon XY Evolutions set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
- [Blastoise Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/blastoise-holo): Base Set - Reverse Holo - 10/102. €189. This Blastoise Reverse Holo #10 is from the popular 2016 Pokémon Base Set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
- [Venusaur Holo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/venusaur-holo): Base Set - 10/102. €159. This Venusaur Reverse Holo #10 is from the popular 2016 Pokémon Base Set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
- [Pikachu Illustrator](https://helloworldcards.com/products/pikachu-illustrator): Base Set - 10/102. €1.200. This Pikachu Illustrator #10 is from the popular 2016 Pokémon Base Set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
- [Mewtwo GX](https://helloworldcards.com/products/mewtwo-gx): Base Set - 10/102. €79. This Mewtwo GX is from the popular 2016 Pokémon Base Set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
- [Eevee Promo](https://helloworldcards.com/products/eevee-promo): Base Set - 10/102. This Eevee Promo is from the popular 2016 Pokémon Base Set. Professionally graded by PSA, the card received an impressive PSA 9 MINT grade.
